title: sendAt defaults to hardcoded '2026-04-30' instead of current time
description: submission.rs:529 — None/null sendAt produces UTCDate::from("2026-04-30T00:00:00Z"), a hardcoded date that was 'today' when the code was written. Any submission created without specifying sendAt will have a wrong timestamp by default. Triggers on every production submission that omits sendAt.
